description: Analyze seams, edge repetition, and brightness continuity of a tileable image, with an optional tiled preview grid. Reads the input and returns a report, or writes a preview PNG only to the explicit output path; never invents filenames.

brightnessMatch.description: Brightness-match axis: horizontal, vertical, or both.

edgeMatch.description: Edge-match axis: horizontal, vertical, or both.

inputPath.description: Raster image or .mcpx path for seam analysis.

outputPngPath.description: Explicit PNG output path. When omitted, the PNG bytes are embedded in the result instead of written to disk.

name: tile_asset
